title: Ella Langley's Choosin' Texas extends its record with a 27th week at number one
summary: No song has spent longer at the top of the Billboard Hot 100.
body:
Ella Langley's "Choosin' Texas" is number one on the Billboard Hot 100 for a 27th week, extending its record for the most weeks at the top in the chart's history.

The country song first reached number one in February. Its weeks at the top are not all in a row.

Breaking records

Earlier this year it passed Mariah Carey's "All I Want for Christmas Is You", which had spent a total of 22 weeks at number one over several holiday seasons.

Halloween also lifted Michael Jackson's "Thriller" back into the top five this week.

Sources: Billboard, Associated Press.
